source_checks.real_updates: Exactly two ranks; positive micro*accum*2=64; engine.backward and engine.step once per micro; engine.global_steps must increase exactly once per64 samples. Scheduler uses full-data-derived cosine with1% warmup, no LR shortcut.

source_checks.adapter_and_inference: All saved adapter tensor keys/shapes/values checked against expected PEFT state; independent inference checks A inter/item/index hashes, tokenizer full vocab and selected input lengths, all loaded adapter tensors in BF16, beam20/max_new_tokens10/EOS. No recommendation metrics.

precision_scope_review.installed_version_pin: PEFT exactly0.5.0; no0.10 environment selected or installed by this code
precision_scope_review.original_diagnostic: A real original SeqRec first_batch runs through the already-DS-BF16 model with no AMP before precision wrapping. Prehooks record actual most-recent LoRA A input/weight/device/AMP. Only RuntimeError containing dtype+float+bfloat16 with observed FP32 input/BF16 weight/no AMP permits adaptation; every other failure is re-raised.
precision_scope_review.no_training_during_diagnostic: No backward, optimizer.step or engine.step; before/after engine global/micro step counts, optimizer state entry count and sampled values across all LoRA and active/frozen embedding/head tensors are asserted unchanged.
precision_scope_review.rng_restore: Torch CPU and this rank CUDA states saved/restored and equality-asserted. Python random and NumPy states saved and restored directly. No other-rank GPU RNG queried; diagnostic graph/batch released before updates.
precision_scope_review.state_limit: No full-model byte identity claim. bnb first-forward CB/SCB/cache readiness may change and is explicitly retained/documented; this deterministic readiness is distinct from optimizer updates. Standard LLaMA has no BatchNorm running statistics.
precision_scope_review.adaptation_trigger_and_targets: Only after matched actual failure, inspect exact PEFT0.5 int8 forward branch and plain nn.Linear LoRA A modules. Each must have CUDA BF16 weights. Runtime instance forward wrapper enables BF16 autocast only when A input is FP32 and weight BF16; otherwise forwards unchanged.
precision_scope_review.excluded_contexts: Parent PEFT forward, bnb base, LoRA dropout/B, whole model and LETTER CE are not wrapped. Global AMP is asserted disabled before/after engine forward and CE. Each A records input/weight/output dtype and inner/outer AMP, with assertions that BF16 A output is produced and AMP exits locally.
precision_scope_review.serialization: Forward method override adds no state_dict parameters/keys and is not silently serialized as model method behavior. Separate vanilla inference path matches original test model class.
precision_scope_review.historical_precision_equivalence: NOT_CLAIMED; author historical framework versions/checkpoint/command remain unbound; approval covers this bounded probe only.

deepspeed_failed_forward_state_review.actual_configuration: ZeRO2, wall_clock_breakdown false, flops profiler disabled
deepspeed_failed_forward_state_review.assessment: EngineTimers forward timer list is empty in this configuration. Stage3-only _parameters._in_forward mutation is not active. ThroughputTimer.start overwrites its started flag/time without asserting prior stop; at initial global_step0 below start_step2 no elapsed training count is accumulated. Diagnostic has no step, so next ordinary forward/step proceeds with unchanged progress. Its small nonnumerical timer readiness is not claimed restored.
deepspeed_failed_forward_state_review.module_call_note: DeepSpeed registers forward hooks on engine.module itself; replacing engine(...) with engine.module(...) would not by itself bypass those hooks. No such unsupported substitution was required.
